note: City of Darlington park on the Pecatonica River at the edge of downtown, where the Cheese Country (Tri-County) recreation trail passes, with a canoe launch, accessible fishing pier and lighted riverside walking path. --Claude
summary: City site refuses (Cloudflare); the claimed RoverPass listing (updated 2026-11-16) gives everything: 41 sites (22 50A, 8 30A, 9 full hookup, 2 non-electric), $25/$50 ($15 non-electric), Instant Book, 14-in-21 max, showers/dump, water off Oct 15-May 15. Waterfront: riverview -> creekside proposed for sites 9-10 (river ~22-27 m wide).
flags: WATERFRONT riverview -> creekside (proposed upgrade, reviewer to decide). The Pecatonica here is ~22-27 m wide on Esri imagery (under 30 m, so creekside, never riverfront). Sites 9 and 10 (50-amp electric, sold nightly; about 42.6801,-90.1216) sit ~35-40 m from the channel across the gravel walking trail and an open grass bank with no tree line. Sites 33-38 (map: a row along the riverside walking trail, about 42.6788,-90.1200) postdate the imagery and could not be checked. Sites 12-13 by the fishing pier have trees between them and the river.

OHV (flag, not a drop): the city park sits on the Cheese Country ATV/rec trail and markets it ('Ride and enjoy the many sights along the famous Cheese Country ATV Trail'; restrooms 'for campers and ATV Trail users'; 'Free parking for daily trail users'). It is a general town campground with a trail side, not a staging camp, by its own description.
